Hayleys Solar introduces SL’s 24/7 Renewable Energy Operations Centre
Hayleys Solar has introduced Sri Lanka’s first dedicated 24/7 Renewable Energy Operations Centre (ROC), enabling continuous monitoring and performance management of renewable energy assets through a centralised digital platform.

SL’s Public debt to fall to 87% by 2032
Sri Lanka’s public debt is projected to decline to 87% of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) by 2032, exceeding the Government’s initial target of 95%, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake said while presenting the 2027 Budget, the third Budget presented by the National People’s Power (NPP)-led Government, in Parliament yesterday (12).
